description: This file defines the LmsService class, which provides core business logic for managing courses, enrollments, assignments, submissions, grades, discussion threads, and posts within a learning management system. It interacts with multiple repository interfaces for data persistence and uses a NotificationService for user notifications.

classes.name: LmsService
classes.description: Service class providing LMS operations such as course management, enrollment, assignment handling, submissions, grading, discussions, and notifications.

methods.name: getCourse
methods.description: Retrieves a course by its ID, throws EntityNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: createCourse
methods.description: Creates a new course with specified details and assigns the owner as INSTRUCTOR, enrolling them automatically.

methods.name: myCourses
methods.description: Returns a list of courses in which the specified user is enrolled.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls a user in a course, notifies the user upon success.

methods.name: createAssignment
methods.description: Creates a new assignment in a course, restricted to instructors.

methods.name: listAssignments
methods.description: Lists all assignments for a course if the user is enrolled.

methods.name: upsertSubmission
methods.description: Creates or updates a student's submission for an assignment, notifies course instructors.

methods.name: gradeSubmission
methods.description: Grades a submission, restricted to instructors, and notifies the student.

methods.name: createThread
methods.description: Creates a discussion thread in a course, requires enrollment.

methods.name: listThreads
methods.description: Lists discussion threads in a course, requires enrollment.

methods.name: addPost
methods.description: Adds a discussion post to a thread, requires enrollment.

methods.name: listPosts
methods.description: Lists posts in a discussion thread, requires enrollment.
